name: RndTrade
summary: RndTrade is an Expert Advisor that opens random trade entries with predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels, functioning as a randomized trading system. It generates trade signals using random number generation rather than technical indicators or market analysis, then manages positions with fixed TP/SL parameters.
summary_zh: RndTrade是一个使用随机数生成入场信号的EA，不依赖任何技术指标或市场分析。它以预设的止盈止损水平开仓，本质上是一个随机交易系统。
strategy_analysis: RndTrade的核心策略概念是基于随机数生成来决定交易方向（买入或卖出），而非基于任何技术分析或市场逻辑。入场条件完全由随机函数触发，每次开仓时随机选择做多或做空，没有任何趋势判断或指标过滤。出场条件依赖于固定的止盈和止损参数，一旦价格触及预设的TP或SL水平即平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户资金或波动性进行动态调整的机制。资金管理方面，该EA没有动态风险控制逻辑，仅依赖固定止损来限制单笔亏损，但缺少最大回撤限制、连续亏损保护等资金管理措施。整体而言，这是一个缺乏策略逻辑的随机交易系统，长期来看期望值接近零（扣除点差后为负）。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of RndTrade is based on random number generation to determine trade direction (buy or sell), rather than any technical analysis or market logic. Entry conditions are entirely triggered by a random function, randomly choosing to go long or short on each trade without any trend judgment or indicator filtering. Exit conditions rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss parameters, closing positions once price hits the predefined TP or SL levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. In terms of money management, the EA lacks dynamic risk control logic, relying solely on fixed stop-loss to limit per-trade losses, but missing equity drawdown limits, consecutive loss protection, or other money management safeguards. Overall, this is a random trading system devoid of strategic logic, with an expected value near zero over the long term (negative after accounting for spreads).

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单

pros: 代码结构简单易懂，适合初学者学习EA基本框架
使用固定止盈止损，单笔风险可控
随机入场可以用于测试市场效率或做对照实验
pros_en: Simple and easy-to-understand code structure, suitable for beginners learning EA frameworks
Uses fixed TP/SL, so per-trade risk is bounded
Random entries can be used to test market efficiency or serve as a control experiment baseline
cons: 完全随机入场无任何策略逻辑，长期必然亏损
缺少资金管理机制如最大回撤限制和连续亏损保护
没有点差过滤和新K线检查，可能在不利条件下频繁交易
没有仓位检查可能重复开仓
未考虑滑点和市场流动性的影响
cons_en: Completely random entries with no strategic logic, guaranteed long-term loss after spreads
Lacks money management mechanisms such as max drawdown limits and consecutive loss protection
No spread filter or new bar check, may trade frequently under unfavorable conditions
No position check could lead to duplicate openings
Does not account for slippage and market liquidity impact
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件，避免在不利市场环境下随机开仓
添加资金管理模块包括最大回撤限制和每日亏损上限
增加新K线检查和点差过滤以减少无效交易
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters to avoid random entries under adverse market conditions
Add a money management module including max drawdown limits and daily loss caps
Add new bar checks and spread filters to reduce ineffective trades

risk_points: 无仓位检查可能导致重复开仓和过度暴露
无新K线检查可能在同一根K线上多次开仓
随机策略本身无正期望值，扣除点差后为负期望
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate openings and overexposure
No new bar check may open multiple trades on the same bar
Random strategy has no positive expected value; negative after spreads
